title: psychotria ligularis var. carapichea
intro: Psychotria ligularis var. carapichea, commonly known as Carapichea ipecacuanha or Ipecacuanha, is a plant species native to South America, particularly in the tropical regions of Brazil and Peru. The health benefits of this plant include its use as an emetic, an expectorant, and a purgative, which have been traditionally employed to treat various ailments such as fever, cough, and diarrhea. The therapeutic actions of Carapichea ipecacuanha are attributed to its emetic properties, which stimulate the vomiting center in the brain, as well as its expectorant properties, which help to loosen and expel mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include ipecac alkaloids, such as emetine and cephaeline, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
